user.title: Add Islautopia Doorbell
user.description: Enter the doorbell's IP address on your local network (skip this if it already showed up as a discovered device). Home Assistant talks to the doorbell only over the local network, never through the internet.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Doorbell found on the network
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found {name} via mDNS. Continue to pair it.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: Enter the administrator email and password you already created on the doorbell itself (app or web dashboard). Used once to obtain an access credential - never stored.

error.not_on_lan: Home Assistant must be on the same network as the doorbell (or a routed VLAN). No direct connection to {host} was possible.
error.other_device: Another device answered at that address, not this doorbell.
error.no_tls: The doorbell answered at {host} but not on its secure port with a valid certificate. A doorbell that has never been online has no certificate yet and cannot be added.
error.pair_verify_failed: Pairing worked but the new credential was rejected over the local network. The pairing was undone on the doorbell; nothing was configured. Try again.
error.label_in_use: Another user of this doorbell already has a client named like this Home Assistant. Change the Home Assistant name (Settings > System > General) and try again.
error.device_not_paired: The doorbell itself isn't registered yet - wait a moment and try again
error.cloud_authorize_failed: The doorbell could not register this pairing - try again later

abort.no_device_id: The mDNS announcement didn't include a valid device_id
abort.not_on_lan: Home Assistant must be on the same network as the doorbell (or a routed VLAN). No direct connection to {host} was possible.
abort.other_device: Another device answered at that address, not this doorbell.
abort.no_tls: The doorbell answered at {host} but not on its secure port with a valid certificate. A doorbell that has never been online has no certificate yet and cannot be added.

menu_options.entidades: Entities the doorbell can act on

entidades.title: Entities the doorbell can act on
entidades.description: Pick the entities you want to be able to trigger from the doorbell - to unlock the door, or from a step in one of its sequences. Only these will be offered in the apps. Up to {max}.

direccion.title: Doorbell address
direccion.description: The doorbell's IP address on your local network. Change it if the doorbell moved (new IP or VLAN). Home Assistant only reaches the doorbell at this address.

reemparejar.title: Re-pair
reemparejar.description: Use this if the access credential was revoked. Enter the doorbell's administrator email/password again.

error.not_on_lan: Home Assistant must be on the same network as the doorbell (or a routed VLAN). No direct connection to {host} was possible.
error.other_device: Another device answered at that address, not this doorbell.
error.no_tls: The doorbell answered at {host} but not on its secure port with a valid certificate.
error.pair_verify_failed: Pairing worked but the new credential was rejected over the local network. The pairing was undone on the doorbell.
error.device_not_paired: The doorbell itself isn't registered yet
error.cloud_authorize_failed: The doorbell could not register this pairing
error.demasiadas: Too many entities - pick {max} at most

play_sequence.name: Play sequence
play_sequence.description: Run one of the doorbell's sequences (a quick reply that can speak, turn on a light or extend the recording).

seq_id.name: Sequence id
seq_id.description: Id of the sequence on the doorbell.

play_audio.name: Play quick reply
play_audio.description: Play the audio stored in a quick-reply slot through the doorbell's speaker.
